description: This header file declares exported API functions related to the Http Webc Trans Object within an HTTP implementation module. It provides prototype declarations for functions to create, remove, enroll objects, and initialize the Webc Trans Object, serving as an interface for external modules to interact with this component.

methods.name: HttpCreateWebcTrans
methods.description: Creates a new Webc Trans object with specified contexts.

methods.name: HttpWctoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Webc Trans Object.

methods.name: HttpWctoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the Webc Trans Object instance.

methods.name: HttpWctoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls the required objects into the Webc Trans Object.

methods.name: HttpWctoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Webc Trans Object instance.
